The spec is revised. Let me note the checklist stays valid, then bring it back for your approval.

The updated checklist still passes (no `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers — I folded your requirements into concrete requirements and left three low-stakes items as "open decisions" you can steer or leave to the stated defaults).

**Revised spec is back at the specification gate** — `specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md`. Here's what changed from round 1:

## Your changes, now in the spec

| Your request | How it's captured |
|---|---|
| Auto-collect title, description, favicon, preview image; edit title/description | US-1, FR-002, FR-003, FR-005 |
| Re-saving an existing address → go to it to edit (not just warn) | US-2, FR-007, FR-008 |
| Case-insensitive search over title/address/description/notes/tags; phrases, `#tag`, AND/OR/NOT, parentheses | US-3, FR-011, FR-012 |
| Tag suggestions from tags you've used | US-7, FR-017 |
| Read-later state + separate unread view + mark read | US-5, FR-014 |
| Archiving as reversible alternative to delete, own view | US-6, FR-015 |
| Bulk select (incl. all-matching) → tag/read/archive/delete | US-9, FR-019, FR-020 |
| Sorting choices, not just newest-first | US-3, FR-010 |
| Description + formatted note per bookmark | US-8, FR-018 |
| Preserved page copy, keep PDF, optional Internet Archive | US-11, FR-022, FR-023 |
| Reusable saved views (search + included/excluded tags) | US-10, FR-021 |
| Import/export browser HTML; import keeps titles, tags, dates | US-12, FR-024, FR-025 |
| Display prefs: default sort, item count, text size | US-13, FR-026 |
| Browser extension out of scope | Assumptions |

Single-user/no-login and tags-over-folders are recorded as confirmed.

## Three small open decisions (won't block — defaults noted)

1. **Formatted note** — I assumed lightweight markdown-style formatting (headings, bold/italic, lists, links). Want full rich-text instead?
2. **Preserved copy** — I assumed one self-contained snapshot captured at save time. Want version history over time?
3. **Internet Archive** — fine that it needs outbound internet and may be unavailable offline?

A note on scope: this is now a **substantial** app (13 user stories). It's all buildable, and the priorities (P1 → P3) mean we can deliver a working MVP early and layer the rest. If you'd rather trim v1, I can mark some P3 stories as "later" before we plan — just say the word.

Per the workflow, I'm **still paused before planning**. Reply with approval (and any steer on the three decisions), and I'll proceed to **speckit-plan**.
